task: Exp36 closes the three named gaps left by Exp35: non-target modal flips 6.25-6.29% versus the 5% isolation budget, analog mean-occupancy readout instead of noisy single-shot readout, and target-centred ideal local bumps instead of a physical surface-field kernel. Exp35 v2/v3 outputs, code, figure and H52/2z records are preserved unchanged.

physical_kernel.basis: One uniform body-voltage column plus a 4x4 array of surface segment modes centred at x,y in {7.5,22.5,37.5,52.5} nm on the z=0 conducting-plane side of the 60 nm island. A segment column at atom position (x,y,z) is exp[-((x-x0)^2+(y-y0)^2)/(2*15^2)] * exp(-z/50), distances in nm. This is an electrostatic surrogate kernel, not a layout claim.
physical_kernel.solve: At every round solve min_a ||B_T a-d||^2 + mu_BG ||B_BG a||^2 + 1e-3 ||a||^2. Main protocols use mu_BG=0.02; the ablation uses mu_BG=0. Segment coefficients clip to +/-0.80 V; the uniform coefficient is clipped so the effective body voltage stays in 0.805-1.006 V.
physical_kernel.initial_desired_correction: From the Exp35 G operating point: for target bit 1, d=max(0,address-Vb_G+5 mV); for bit 0, d=min(0,address-Vb_G-5 mV). Feedback changes a wrong target's desired correction by 20 mV in the required direction, clipped to +/-180 mV.

readout_protocols.SEG-ANA: Physical kernel with Exp35-style analog mean-occupancy feedback (proportional desired-correction update 25 meV per unit occupancy error), at most 8 updates; isolates kernel/background effects from readout noise.
readout_protocols.SEG-SS1: One terminal physical snapshot per 600-sweep round, each target bit independently flipped by the sensor with p=0.01. Binary-error updates only; stop after 2 consecutive observed-exact rounds or 12 rounds.
readout_protocols.SEG-SS5: Three terminal snapshots per round, each bit flipped with p=0.05 and majority-estimated. Binary-error updates only; stop after 2 consecutive estimated-exact rounds or 12 rounds.
readout_protocols.SEG-SS1-U: SEG-SS1 ablation with mu_BG=0 (no background penalty).
readout_protocols.verification: Controller decisions use only the named readout. Reported marginals/exact fractions/background flips come from a separate fresh-RNG 1200-sweep verification segment with the controller frozen.

basis_disclosed: Exp35 outcomes and task-level failure patterns, the Exp24 island geometry (x,y in 0..60 nm, z in 2..150 nm), calibrated addresses and the corrected Exp24-faithful sampler are known. No Exp36 actuator solve, pattern outcome, readout trajectory, or depth statistic has been computed.
